meta.title: Acme Bank | Mobile App
meta.description: The official Acme Bank mobile app — secure, convenient digital banking.

hero.subhead: Secure, convenient, and fully digital banking — anywhere, anytime, 24/7.

features.label: What You Can Do
features.heading: Everything You Need, Right in Your Phone
features.intro: Manage your finances with confidence using the full suite of digital tools in the Acme Mobile app.

items.title: Secure Authentication
items.body: Log in safely using your PIN, biometrics, or two-factor authentication.

items.title: Fund Transfers
items.body: Transfer funds instantly to other accounts or external banks — fast and reliable.

items.title: Account Overview
items.body: View balances, transaction history, and e-statements anytime, anywhere.

items.title: Bills Payment
items.body: Pay utility bills and other obligations directly through the app.

items.title: 24/7 Support
items.body: Access in-app support, FAQs, and direct contact channels day or night.

items.title: Trusted Security
items.body: Bank-grade security and regulatory compliance keep your deposits protected.

support.label: App Support & Contact
support.heading: We're Here to Help
support.intro: For any questions, concerns, or technical issues with the app, reach out through any channel below.

privacy.label: Legal & Data Privacy
privacy.heading: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Acme Bank is committed to protecting the privacy and security of all information you share with us.
